For one of our clients we are looking for a Piping Design Engineer!

 

For questions please contact recruiter Maria Johansen;

Maria.helgesen.johansen@modis.no, 0047 953 32 747

 

Planned start date: 02.08.21

Planned end date: 31.12.22 

 

Job Responsibilities

• 3D design of piping with use of E3D/ PDMS • Generate 2D Drawings/ Draft• Be able to use 3D review tool and participate in design review• Insert data to engineering registry

Required Education

• Masters or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering

Required Work Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in process engineering within the Oil & Gas industry in Norway• Experience from study work at all phases• Broad experience in use of E3D software incl. draft• Be familiar with the other main subject areas within piping (Layout, support, stress, material handling)• Have good knowledge to laws, standards, and norms applicable for the discipline

Required Qualifications

• Have good communication skills in English and Norwegian(preferable) both orally and in writing• Have a cooperative working attitude • Be systematic and accurate • Have a high loyalty to deadline and quality requirements • Have the ability to see multiple design – cases (solution oriented)

Overview:We're looking for a highly experienced and dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer to join our team. This pivotal role involves leading the design and specification of comprehensive electrical system solutions for significant projects across their study, FEED, and detailed phases, with a focus on land cables, subsea cables, and HV equipment in both onshore and offshore substations. You'll be responsible for the Main Power Supply Package Specification, ensuring all requirements align with industry standards and project goals. Your expertise will be needed in managing high-voltage packages. If you're a proactive, systematic, and collaborative individual with experience in electrification and a deep understanding of relevant electrical standards, we encourage you to apply. Main Tasks:
• Design and specify electrical system solutions and strategies for projects during the study, FEED, and detailed phases.
• Collaborate closely with project and company representatives across disciplines.
• Responsible for the Main Power Supply Package Specification, detailing the technical and functional requirements for high- and low-voltage suppliers to ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and project needs.
• Manage high-voltage packages, including transformers, gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), and variable speed drives (VSD), from development through execution. This includes detailed engineering, fabrication, logistics, installation, contract management, and final handover to operations.
• Follow up electrical system calculations, analyses and assessments.Qualifications:
• EX: Basic EX course. 6-8 hours online, or 22.5 in the classroom.
• FSE: with first aid.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in Electrical Engineering from Norwegian continental shelf projects.  
• Experience with high-voltage packages such as transformers, gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), and variable speed drives (VSD).
• Solid understanding of electrical system analysis and transmission systems.
• Experience from offshore electrification projects.
• Experience and deep knowledge of electrical design according to relevant standards such as NORSOK, ATEX, PTIL, ISO, DNV and IEC.
• Efficient communicator in English, both orally and in writing.Ready to make an impact? We invite you to submit your application!

Overview:We're looking for a skilled and experienced Automation / Senior Engineer to join our team for an exciting project. In this role, you will be key to designing, integrating, and following up on critical safety and automation systems. You will develop detailed SAS Safety system designs, ensuring they align with project requirements and seamlessly integrate with existing plant infrastructure.This position involves close collaboration with other disciplines, contractors, suppliers, and clients. If you're a proactive problem-solver with a background in automation engineering and SIS system design, and you thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment, we'd love to hear from you!Main Tasks:
• System Design, interface, and follow up of ESD, PSD and F&G System as appointed by automation team lead.
• Develop SAS Safety system design according to project needs.
• Design and specify SIS solutions that are aligned with existing plant, for integration of SIS systems.
• Specification of Global SIS system design through contractual interfaces.
• Participation in multidiscipline reviews.
• Ensure that vendor and engineering information needed for progress of the work is identified and communicated to the project.
• Interface to other disciplines, contractors, suppliers and client.
• Offshore survey may be required.Qualifications:
• Minimum 8 years’ experience from automation engineering in green field projects.
• Minimum 5 years’ experience from automation and SIS system design, including experience with brownfield modifications on a SIS system.
• Experience in automation design and networks according to relevant standards such as NORSOK, ATEX, PTIL, and IEC.
• FSE-course.
• Ex-course.
• Efficient communicator in English - both orally and in writing.If you're excited by this opportunity, we encourage you to apply!
